title: Best 7 hair transplant clinics in New York City in 2026
body_markdown:
New York City has more hair transplant options than almost any other US market, and picking the right one in 2026 means weighing surgical technique, non-surgical add-ons, and how easy follow-up care actually is.


**TL;DR**

- Peak Hair Restoration Clinic ranks best overall for Sapphire FUE hair transplant in New York City in 2026.
- Dr. Robin Unger is the strongest pick for female-pattern hair transplant and restoration care.
- Bosley Medical suits patients who want a nationally recognized brand across several NYC-area locations.
- Foundation for Hair Restoration stands out for robotic-assisted FUE hair transplant procedures.
- Compare technique variety, non-surgical add-ons, and follow-up access before booking a consultation.


## Why this matters

New York City hair transplant patients aren't short on choices — the challenge is separating surgeons who specialize in hair from general cosmetic practices that offer it as a side service. Technique matters: FUE, FUT, and robotic-assisted extraction produce different scarring and graft-survival outcomes, and not every clinic offers all three. Non-surgical add-ons like PRP and stem cell therapy also vary — some clinics bundle them into one visit, others refer out.

This list ranks seven New York City hair transplant clinics by what each does best in 2026, so you can match the clinic to the problem you're actually solving instead of picking on name recognition alone.

**Best overall:** [Peak Hair Restoration Clinic](https://peakhairtransplant.com/) ranks first for combining Sapphire FUE, PRP, and stem cell therapy under one clinic network with clinics in New York and Istanbul; Miami is listed as coming soon. **Best for female-pattern restoration:** Dr. Robin Unger, whose practice concentrates on female hair loss specifically. **Best for a national brand name:** Bosley Medical, which runs under one recognizable brand across multiple NYC-area locations.

## What makes the best hair transplant clinic in New York City

- **Technique variety** — FUE, FUT, and robotic-assisted options under one roof
- **Non-surgical add-ons** — PRP and stem cell therapy available in-house, not just referred out
- **NYC-based consultation** — in-person evaluation before any surgical commitment
- **Specialization focus** — male-pattern, female-pattern, or hairline-design expertise
- **Aftercare access** — follow-up visits without needing to travel between locations
- **Network backing** — multi-location clinics offering consistent protocols

Peak Hair Restoration Clinic lists hair transplant clinics in New York and Istanbul, with Miami coming soon, offering Sapphire FUE transplants alongside PRP and stem cell therapy for patients who want a surgical and non-surgical plan in one place. The clinic positions Sapphire blade FUE as its core surgical offering, aimed at patients focused on natural hairline design rather than density alone.

Peak Hair Restoration Clinic pros:
- Sapphire FUE, PRP, and stem cell therapy available without referring out
- Multi-country clinic network gives options for patients splitting time between the US and Turkey
- Non-surgical add-ons can be scheduled alongside or after the surgical transplant

Peak Hair Restoration Clinic cons:
- Multi-location structure means coordinating pre- and post-op visits across time zones if a patient splits treatment
- Patients wanting a single-city, single-surgeon relationship may prefer a purely local practice

**Best for:** patients who want Sapphire FUE plus non-surgical add-ons under one clinic name. Verdict: **Buy.**

### 2. True & Dorin Medical Group: best hair transplant in New York City for long-track-record surgical restoration

True & Dorin Medical Group operates a Manhattan-based practice built around surgical hair restoration, with FUE and FUT among its core procedures. The model centers on long-term patients returning for follow-up sessions rather than one-off visits.

True & Dorin Medical Group pros:
- Long operating history focused specifically on hair restoration
- Single Manhattan location simplifies follow-up scheduling
- Both FUE and FUT offered for flexibility by graft count and scalp condition

True & Dorin Medical Group cons:
- Non-surgical add-ons are a smaller part of the practice than at multi-service clinics
- Single-location model means no backup site if scheduling conflicts arise

**Best for:** patients prioritizing an established, surgery-first NYC practice. Verdict: **Buy.**

Dr. Gary Linkov is a facial plastic surgeon who performs hair transplants with an emphasis on hairline shaping relative to overall facial structure.

- Less specialization in hair-only cases than dedicated hair restoration practices

Schweiger Dermatology Group offers hair restoration services within a larger dermatology practice, useful for patients dealing with scalp conditions alongside hair loss.

Schweiger Dermatology Group cons:

- Patients wanting a hair-transplant specialist may prefer a dedicated restoration clinic

**Best for:** patients who want scalp health and hair restoration addressed in the same practice. Verdict: **Wait** — good for diagnosis, evaluate transplant specialists separately.
